title: Olive Tries a New Snack
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 2, week 4 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell ore, oor, our
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Olive spots a new little snack on the compost heap.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl perched on the edge of a compost heap, looking at a small unfamiliar item resting on top.

pages.text: Olive has not seen this snack before.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl tilting her head, studying the unfamiliar snack closely.

pages.text: Olive has a sniff of the snack.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl leaning in close to sniff at the snack.
Olive the owl taking a small, careful bite of the snack.

pages.text: The snack smells sharp to Olive.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl blinking, her beak still on the snack, eyes a little wide.
Olive the owl pulling a scrunched-up, surprised face.

pages.text: Olive can not say if she likes it.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking thoughtfully at the rest of the snack, unsure.

pages.text: Nell says to just try one more bite.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering beside Olive, encouraging her towards the snack.

pages.text: Olive takes one more bite and smiles.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl taking another bite, this time smiling.

pages.text: Olive grins. The new snack is good after all.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl grinning, finishing off the last of the snack happily.
